note: State-specific direct cremation figures, shown only where a funeral consumer organization publishes a statewide summary figure. Figures are shown as published (no inflation adjustment, no averaging across states). Map V3.6, Randy, November 2026.

Washington.sample: People's Memorial Association surveyed 250 Washington funeral homes in 2024 (some did not participate); the average is of the prices reported.
Washington.definition: The price each funeral home lists for Direct Cremation on its General Price List. The survey does not state whether a cremation container or crematory fee is included.
Washington.source: People's Memorial Association, 2024 Funeral Home Price Survey
